The retiree health plan's prior-service credit, which props up adjusted EPS, runs out during 2027 (other income ~2,290 in 2026 -> ~1,189 in 2027 and ~551 after; 1,166 after tax left at mid-2026, Q2 10-Q), and SpaceX's mobile entry takes about 0.44M / 0.67M of AT&T's 2028-29 phone adds on top of the post-SpaceX 6.1x multiple Kilian kept. Revenue per phone is built from price actions, fiber adds from a 5.5% take rate on unconnected fiber locations, Internet Air adds fade, and AC EBITDA follows a 0.844 flow-through on service revenue from a Q4 2026 base of 11,699 built from its causes; AC D&A comes from the dep_engine.py vintage book. The result sits below management and consensus on cash: 2028 adjusted EPS $2.92 vs the $2.82 floor, FCF $17.7B / $20.0B vs $19B+ / $21B+, consolidated EBITDA 1.5% under consensus in 2028 (51,145 vs 51,933, MarketScreener 2026-11-24). Kilian kept the driver-built EBITDA path and the booked Q4 2026 capex, Internet Air and Legacy paths (cards 2026-11-18/19).
